023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper;
024
025import com.google.inject.Inject;
026import org.opt4j.core.Individual;
027import org.opt4j.core.Objective;
028import org.opt4j.core.Objectives;
029import org.opt4j.core.Value;
030import org.opt4j.core.optimizer.Archive;
031import org.opt4j.core.optimizer.Optimizer;
032import org.opt4j.core.optimizer.OptimizerIterationListener;
033import org.opt4j.core.optimizer.OptimizerStateListener;
034import org.opt4j.core.start.Constant;
035
036import java.io.BufferedWriter;
037import java.io.File;
038import java.io.FileWriter;
039import java.io.IOException;
040import java.util.ArrayList;
041import java.util.Collections;
042import java.util.Comparator;
043import java.util.List;
044
045public class EvaluationLogger implements OptimizerIterationListener, OptimizerStateListener {
046
047    private final Archive archive;
048    private final DominancePredictionManager manager;
049    private final String filename;
050    private BufferedWriter writer;
051    private long startTime;
052    private boolean headerWritten = false;
053    private List<Objective> sortedObjectives;
054
055    @Inject
056    public EvaluationLogger(Archive archive, DominancePredictionManager manager,
057                                @Constant(value = "tsvFilename", namespace = NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) String filename) {
058        this.archive = archive;
059        this.manager = manager;
060        this.filename = filename == null ? "run.tsv" : filename;
061    }
062
063    @Override
064    public void optimizationStarted(Optimizer optimizer) {
065        startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
066        try {
067            File file = new File(filename);
068            if (file.getParentFile() != null) file.getParentFile().mkdirs();
069            writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(file));
070        } catch (IOException e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public void optimizationStopped(Optimizer optimizer) {
075        if (writer != null) {
076            try { writer.close(); } catch (IOException e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
077        }
078    }
079
080    @Override
081    public void iterationComplete(int iteration) {
082        if (writer == null) return;
083        try {
084            if (!headerWritten && !archive.isEmpty()) writeHeader(archive.iterator().next().getObjectives());
085            if (headerWritten) {
086                int trueEvaluations = manager.getEvaluatedCount();
087                double runtime = (System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime) / 1000.0;
088                for (Individual ind : archive) {
089                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
090                    sb.append(iteration).append("\t").append(trueEvaluations).append("\t").append(runtime);
091                    for (Objective obj : sortedObjectives) {
092                        sb.append("\t");
093                        Value<?> v = ind.getObjectives().get(obj);
094                        if (v == null || v == Objective.INFEASIBLE) sb.append("INFEASIBLE");
095                        else sb.append(v.getDouble());
096                    }
097                    writer.write(sb.toString());
098                    writer.newLine();
099                }
100                writer.flush();
101            }
102        } catch (IOException e) { e.printStackTrace(); }
103    }
104
105    private void writeHeader(Objectives sampleObjectives) throws IOException {
106        sortedObjectives = new ArrayList<>(sampleObjectives.getKeys());
107        Collections.sort(sortedObjectives, Comparator.comparing(Objective::getName));
108        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("iteration\tevaluations\truntime[s]");
109        for (Objective obj : sortedObjectives) {
110            sb.append("\t").append(obj.getName());
111            sb.append(obj.getSign() == Objective.Sign.MIN ? "[MIN]" : "[MAX]");
112        }
113        writer.write(sb.toString());
114        writer.newLine();
115        headerWritten = true;
116    }
117}
